title: AbCellera announces positive top-line Phase 2 results for ABCL635
publisher: AbCellera Biologics Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: The study met the primary efficacy endpoints achieving statistically significant reductions in both frequency and severity of VMSM-S at week 4 compared to placebo after a single dose.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release reports controlled week-four efficacy, sleep and patient-global-impression improvements, and initial four-week tolerability for ABCL635 in 92 randomized participants.
